title: Predict Destruction Order
prompt: Implement `teardownOrder(int n)` returning the destruction order of n guard objects numbered 1..n constructed in order inside one scope, as a comma-joined string like "3,2,1".

tests.name: reverse order
tests.hint: Within a scope, destruction runs in reverse construction order.

tests.name: single object
tests.hint: n == 1 is just "1" — no reversal visible.
